GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Race started cloaked in fog, misty rain and gloom. Settled Down 2 Lengths 3 Wide , Drifted Back to 3 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: Rider opined it did not handle the heavy track conditions. Post-race vet exam revealed a slower than normal recovery and bilateral discharge. Vet clearance including endoscopic exam results required.] # always Wide

Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 3.5 Lengths on fence, little change to 4 Lengths rail turning, Held Up home turn and blocked until pushing oiff and around heels at 350m, Made Some Ground to the line. (Blinkers AGAIN, Winkers OFF FIRST TIME) [Stewards: Underwent pre-race vet exam. Cleared to start.] # needed more luck
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Vetted pre-race. Began awkwardly and then bumped. Held up for clear running leaving the 600m and steadied, continued to be held up until leaving the 400m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 3 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 4 Lengths turning, Held Up rounding turn then couldn't really come on in straight. [Stewards: Rider reported it would appreciate a step-up in distance.] # Had its chances
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up rounding the home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 6th Four Wide with a trail 3 Lengths , in Clear Outside Straightening Up had its chance ! Hard Ridden 300m Just Kept Going One Pace - # not up to it
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race vet exam revealed a significant laceration to the near hind. Vet cert prior to racing again.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Ridden Along Settled Down 2nd 1 Lengths off leader/winner held together same to straightening up Kept Trying but had its chance was (t/t/1st w/1st) # no match at all
Jumped Ok Not Bustled hence Settled Down 4th Inside 3 Lengths off leader/winner 3rd x 600 2 Lengths clear run home Outside couldn't quicken couldn't finish off - # Just Battled
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly for a short distance near the 800m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained thus Settled Down 6th Outside 5 Lengths off leader/winner No Pace On Not Given Much Hope doing that, this was kept Under Good Hold until Straightening Up went wide ran on to the line Sound Effort (b/off) # bird had flown
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide until the 1150m. Held up on entering the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1.0 Lengths improving between rivals Soon After settled worse Mid Field 7-8 Lengths off rail (1000m), coming up 4 deep approaching Turn , wider for home looked spent, no run on (jock stated the gelding became quite agitated pre-race, was inclined to lay in for the majority and proved disappointing) # lost chance start
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Passing the 300m, contacted on several occasions. Rdr stated gelding became quite agitated pre-race, was inclined to lay in for the majority and proved disappointing. A post-race vet exam revealed no abs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast comf Went Forward sit 2nd Outside 1 Lengths race very much run to suit , held together same to straightening up Under Pressure x 300m, Couldn'T Go On @ 200m, # had its chance

Jumped well looked like settling second however going through along Inside underneath leader (1000m), took over Soon After , travelled well To The Turn , challenged into the Straight Quickly Under Pressure , didn't shirk it rallying right to the line just outgunned # game/run short?

Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 4th Inside 2 Lengths No Pace On locked away nowhere to go until the Straightening Up Under Pressure x 300m Couldn'T Go On @ 100m was unlayable and the well supported stablemate won - # Inconclusive
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When asked about performance, Rdr reported gelding travelled well in the early and middle stages, however when placed under pressure, failed to respond to riding and proved disappointing. A post-race vet exam revealed no abs.
